rationale: Complete the vote-durability question's index to match its interpretation, which now also relies on the batch-ordering entry that records the early readiness release and the post-save vote response. The question already lists the SaveRaftState ordering entry; the second entry is added with the assertion actually used. No question text, disposition or interpretation changes.

knowledge.assertion: Non-free-order messages, including RequestVoteResp and HeartbeatResp, are forwarded only after the batch's raft state has been committed atomically.
The same batch loop releases readiness signals before SaveRaftState but sends vote responses only after it, so the early-release path does not carry election state.
